example: Original two-byte unsigned big-endian body length with 1..8-byte pedagogic body policy: 00 03 41 42 43 00 02 44 45 encodes ABC then DE. Split after first header byte and first body byte, alternatively combined input. 00 09 and 00 00 rejected by chosen policy; EOF with partial header/body is truncation.
limits: Paper reasoning only; no runtime, sockets, native library, or game results.
Single-frame declared-size check is not a total allocation, queue, CPU, or timeout bound.
Framing does not establish identity, authorization, semantic validity, or business success.
No changes to ENet, HTTP range, Zstandard, or audio framing mechanisms.
